definitions.explanation: Feeling that something is too much effort or bother to do. Describes the reluctance to do something because it seems tiresome or inconvenient.

examples.japanese: ⟦{外出|がいしゅつ}→外出：02543_gaishutsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{億劫|おっくう}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I find it too bothersome to go out.
On rainy days, going shopping becomes tiresome.
As you get older, everything starts to feel like too much effort.

notes:
{億劫|おっくう} describes a task that feels like more effort than one can face — not that it is difficult, but that getting started is unappealing. The person who feels this way is the topic; what feels burdensome is marked with ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧, usually a nominalized clause ending in ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧.

USAGE:
・〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{億劫|おっくう}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ (it's bothersome to do 〜)
・{億劫|おっくう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧ (to find something tiresome)
・{億劫|おっくう}⟦になる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to come to feel like too much effort)
・As a na-adjective it also modifies nouns directly ({億劫|おっくう}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧), though the predicate use is far more common.

NUANCE:
Expresses 'I know I should do this, but I really don't want to make the effort.' It is about lacking motivation, not about being unable — and it is a statement of one's own feeling, so it is rarely used to describe someone else.

COMMON CONTEXTS:
・⟦{外出|がいしゅつ}→外出：02543_gaishutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{億劫|おっくう} (going out is a bother)
・⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{億劫|おっくう} (cooking is tedious)
・⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{億劫|おっくう} (cleaning is tiresome)

ETYMOLOGY:
Originally a Buddhist term meaning 'one hundred million kalpas,' an inconceivably long stretch of time — hence something that feels as though it would take forever to get through.

RELATED WORDS:
・⟦{面倒|めんどう}→面倒：03809_mendou⟧ (troublesome — about the task itself being fiddly, rather than about one's own reluctance)
・⟦{面倒臭|めんどうくさ}い→面倒臭い：16345_mendoukusai⟧ (a blunter, more colloquial version of the same complaint)
